## Separate new-game branches and unresolved findings

**Opening alternate:** fresh session `b5d42ffd-890a-45b9-9493-c0bcaa6a1263`, created 21:14:46.613Z, skipped phase 0 normally. Delayed pause stayed at tick 8; C01 once, no items, no movement/drain. **Replay/island alternate:** another confirmed New, session `cb2b7258-6120-4bd3-893a-222d522bb62c`, created 21:14:56.468Z, retained phase 2 at tick 24 across pause, then skipped. One C01, no carried-over rewards/gear. Hand-gathered two nursery-cup meals without tools; C03 recorded at tick 1254 precedes C02 recorded at tick 2198 (saved at 2204), with the corresponding combined notebook interpretation. No crafted equipment, failures or rescues; optional journal omitted. This branch stopped after its bounded early-order check.

**EXP-1 — source blocker: negative disabled-hull health makes Save/Export fail.** Only after main completion, imported its own current-source `canopy-reboarded.json` through the actual file input and confirmation to run the bounded depth-limit extension. From accepted `limits-imported.json` tick 18210, quiet diagonal descent encountered a floor/approach boundary near X93. Rose, then used normal throttle east/south; wildlife warning escalated to pursuit. Switching to quiet during pursuit did not save the hull: it disabled near `(135.700,-110.807,-132.387)` before reaching the intended154m check. Stopped this branch immediately; no recovery overlap or production edit.

At tick 19986 the original Dart health was **`-3.2000000000000006`**, disabled, power 94.437657%, emergency air 119.733333 s, same cargo/IDs. F5 and actual Export rejected: “Gameplay ownership, capacity, equipment, discovery, facility, recovery or berth data is invalid. Nothing was loaded.” Autosave disabled itself and left the last valid journal at tick 18210. Thus `limits-failed-disabled.json` is explicitly the **stale valid journal**, not a successful failure snapshot. `limits-unexportable-live-state.json` retains the exact live state via a read-only observation of the unchanged clone used by the actual rejected Export UI; temporary observation wrapper restored in `finally`. It was never used to inject state. All route/key logs and the valid imported original are retained.

Source cause is concrete: `survival.ts:215–219` applies hunter damage to an already-disabled controlled hull; initial disable clamps health to 0, but `updateSurvival` does not disable/clamp it again. Validator requires health 0–100 and `disabled === (health === 0)` (`validation.ts:322/602`). A focused detached diagnostic on the observed live state confirms encode rejection and health −3.4 after one further no-input tick. Root must assign the fix. No importable failing save can be produced through the refusing Save/Export UI; the original, failed-save journal, exact raw state and full inputs are supplied instead.

**EXP-2 — directional launch hint:** `view.ts:423` says north, while successful open-water egress increases Z and the compass shows S. Keep the physical departure result and this concrete copy/compass mismatch separate. Return alignment/ramp/rib collisions described above were retained navigation friction without main injury or rescue; they are not concealed as successful straight paths.

**Unexecuted/limited:** actual deep suit-exit refusal and any180m hull-limit excursion; the failed extension stopped before150m. Both150m suit/180m hull limits were visibly presented, and normal board/exit was exercised, but depth refusal is not claimed. Geometric blocked-output ordinary controls were impractical and diagnostic only. No full alternate Dart route, P4 recovery, F0–F3 carrier, battery-exhaustion marathon, native focus/lock matrix, dedicated-GPU/audible-quality or human play acceptance. Earlier misleading attempt filenames remain indexed honestly rather than overwritten with later success.
